title: Detailed diamond
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='gemTop' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#b8f4ff'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#6ee8ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#3cc8f0'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='gemMid' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#8af0ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2ab8e8'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='gemBottom' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0.5' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#5cd8f8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#1a8cc0'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='gemLeft' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#d6faff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#9aeeff'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='gemRight' x1='1' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7de4ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#40c4ec'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Outer glow/shadow shape for depth -->
  <polygon points='50,8 86,36 68,86 32,86 14,36' fill='#1a4a6a' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Crown (top section) -->
  <!-- Left crown facet -->
  <polygon points='50,10 26,34 50,46' fill='url(#gemLeft)'/>
  <!-- Center crown facet -->
  <polygon points='50,10 74,34 50,46' fill='url(#gemRight)'/>
  <!-- Top-left crown facet -->
  <polygon points='50,10 14,36 26,34' fill='#c8f8ff'/>
  <!-- Top-right crown facet -->
  <polygon points='50,10 86,36 74,34' fill='#a0f0ff'/>
  <!-- Left outer crown facet -->
  <polygon points='14,36 26,34 50,46' fill='url(#gemTop)'/>
  <!-- Right outer crown facet -->
  <polygon points='86,36 74,34 50,46' fill='url(#gemMid)'/>

  <!-- Girdle (widest part) highlight line -->
  <polygon points='14,36 50,46 86,36 86,38 50,48 14,38' fill='#e8ffff' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- Pavilion (lower section) -->
  <!-- Left pavilion facet -->
  <polygon points='14,36 50,46 50,88' fill='url(#gemMid)'/>
  <!-- Right pavilion facet -->
  <polygon points='86,36 50,46 50,88' fill='url(#gemBottom)'/>
  <!-- Left-middle pavilion facet -->
  <polygon points='14,36 32,60 50,46' fill='#6ee0f8'/>
  <!-- Right-middle pavilion facet -->
  <polygon points='86,36 68,60 50,46' fill='#50d0f0'/>
  <!-- Left lower pavilion facet -->
  <polygon points='32,60 50,46 50,88' fill='#38c0e8'/>
  <!-- Right lower pavilion facet -->
  <polygon points='68,60 50,46 50,88' fill='#2aaed8'/>
  <!-- Bottom tip accent -->
  <polygon points='32,60 68,60 50,88' fill='#44c8ec' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Bright spakle highlights -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='12' r='2.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='18' cy='36' r='1.8' fill='#e0fffe' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='36' r='1.8' fill='#e0fffe' opacity='0.8'/>
  <polygon points='50,8 52,14 50,12 48,14' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>

  <!-- Inner sparkle -->
  <polygon points='50,30 51.5,33 55,33 52.5,35.5 53.5,39 50,37 46.5,39 47.5,35.5 45,33 48.5,33' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Tiny star sparkles -->
  <polygon points='30,20 31,23 34,23 31.5,25 32.5,28 30,26.5 27.5,28 28.5,25 26,23 29,23' fill='#e8ffff' opacity='0.5'/>
  <polygon points='70,18 71,21 74,21 71.5,23 72.5,26 70,24.5 67.5,26 68.5,23 66,21 69,21' fill='#e8ffff' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
